mission: Combine the most promising weaknesses discovered by earlier profiles, one ingredient at a time, and measure how severity changes.
mindset: Do not start here. Earn the Final Boss by learning the program first. Combine what nearly broke, not arbitrary stress.
opening_moves: Rank earlier findings by severity/interaction potential.
Choose two or three compatible weaknesses.

escalation_ladder.name: Pairwise fusion
actions: Combine two while holding others constant.

escalation_ladder.name: Three-way chain
actions: Add a third only if pairwise interaction matters.

escalation_ladder.name: Recovery boss
actions: Attempt supported recovery, destroy sandbox, verify original integrity.

signature_tactics.name: Weakness fusion
signature_tactics.purpose: Turn small weaknesses into compound failure.

signature_tactics.name: Normal-task-under-chaos
actions: Perform Expert Baseline golden-path action in compound state.

signature_tactics.name: Recovery under pressure
signature_tactics.purpose: Test escape from worst discovered state.

combination_rules: Increase one ingredient at a time.
Zero-trace verification outranks all other results.
stop_conditions: Enough evidence exists without more escalation.
